## Open by design

Open science is not an appendix to our research. We support research cultures
in which methods, uncertainty and limitations are visible—and where reusable
tools can travel further than a single paper.

Our principles are:

- Transparent analysis plans, code and materials whenever ethically and legally possible.
- Statistical education that builds understanding, not ritualised software use.
- Robust workflows that welcome checking, replication and constructive correction.

## Italian Reproducibility Network

Michele Scandola serves as Secretary of the Italian Reproducibility Network,
a peer-led consortium working to strengthen robust research, reproducibility
and collective learning across Italian institutions.
